newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau sees rise in tourist arrivals in Q1 97.
newsitem.headline: Macau sees rise in tourist arrivals in Q1 97.

text.p: Over two million tourists visited Macau in the first quarter of 1997, up 2.7 percent from the same period in 1996, Macau's statistics and census department said on Sunday.
The number of tourists from China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea and Britain and the United States grew but arrivals from Hong Kong and Thailand fell, it said.
Local tourism officials blamed the fall in the number of Hong Kong tourists on the Hong Kong media's coverage of Macau's problem with rising crime.
Macau has been battling a rising wave of crime in recent months, exacerbated by gangland violence.
